explication: MP Manager is an Android dual-pane file manager with extensive APK and device-tool capabilities. The documented user flow is to browse or search files, perform file operations or open a specialized viewer/editor, and then share or install the result. The README excerpt documents these capabilities, but ends during APK tools; additional subsystems visible in the tree are represented cautiously. Sampled source excerpts are incomplete, so links not established by the README or source index are omitted.
